message: and it is no container ARIA names as a whole
$reason: `name-on-a-region-around-the-trigger` with `TABINDEX` in capitals and the trigger inside named as well: the same name on a stop and on the control within it. HTML ignores the case of an attribute's name, so the region takes focus; the tag scan looked the key up as written, found no `tabindex`, and read a landmark no user lands on — no widget, so no carrier to ask what it holds — while the trigger carried the name for the component and the case passed. The walk reads the name as the parser and the DOM do.
